entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that in respect of a food sample drawn by the Food Inspector in a raid on 31.5.2011, at the premises of the applicants' cold storage, a complaint under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (old Act) is not maintainable as the provisions of Sections 41/42 relating to search / seizure under the new Act had come to be in force on 31.7.2009.

The seminal issue before the court is as to which law would govern the prosecution of the applicants,
in respect of drawl of a food sample on 31.5.2011, from the premises of the applicants' cold storage,
i.e. the "new Act" or the "old Act."
The various provisions of the new Act have been enforced on different dates.
Section 41 of the Act relates to power of search, seizure, investigation, prosecution and procedure thereto which came into effect from 31.7.2009.

Section 41 (1) thereof provides that notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (2) of Section 31, the Food Safety Officer may search any place, seize any article of food or adulterant, if there is any reasonable doubt for being involved in any commission of offence relating to food and shall thereafter inform the designated officer of the actions taken by him in writing.

Section 97 of the new Act as enforced w.e.f. 29.7.2010 relates to Repeal and Savings which provides that w.e.f the date i.e., 5.8.2011 as the Central Government appoints in this behalf the enactment and orders specified in the 2nd schedule shall stand repealed, provided that the said repeal shall not affect the previous operations of the enactments and orders under repeal or anything duly done or suffered thereunder; or any right, privilege, obligation or liability acquired, accrued or incurred under any of the enactment or orders under repeal; or any penalty, forfeiture or punishment incurred in respect of any offence committed against the enactment and orders under repeal; or any investigation or remedy in respect of any such penalty, forfeiture or punishment.
The Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (37 of 1954) along with other enactments are contained in the second schedule appended to the new Act.

entities.text: Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (37 of 1954)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The old Act came to be repealed in view of the notification dated 5.8.2011 issued under Section 97 of the new Act.

Consequently, the alleged raid on 31.5.2011 stands saved under the proviso to Section 97 of the new Act, but prosecution on the basis of the complaint dated 7.1.2012 under the old Act, will not be maintainable as the provisions of the old Act came to be repealed w.e.f. 5.8.2011.

The proceedings of Complaint Case No.13/2012, under Sections 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, P.S. Fajalganj, Kanpur Nagar, pending in the court of Metropolitan Magistrate-I, Kanpur Nagar are quashed.
